patch.content:
# Enable the settings subsystem
CONFIG_SETTINGS=y

# Select the Flash Circular Buffer (FCB) backend for settings
CONFIG_SETTINGS_FCB=y

# Enable the Flash Circular Buffer (FCB) module itself,
# which is a dependency for CONFIG_SETTINGS_FCB.
CONFIG_FCB=y

# FCB relies on flash memory, so enable flash support.
CONFIG_FLASH=y
CONFIG_FLASH_PAGE_LAYOUT=y

# Enable console for test output
CONFIG_CONSOLE=y
CONFIG_UART_CONSOLE=y
CONFIG_PRINTK=y

# Enable Newlib C library for standard functions
CONFIG_NEWLIB_LIBC=y

# Increase stack size for tests if needed
CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=2048
CONFIG_SYSTEM_WORKQUEUE_STACK_SIZE=1024

# Enable testing framework
CONFIG_ZTEST=y
CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y
